lines.en: Lesson 26
lines.zh: 第26课

lines.en: Wanted: a large biscuit tin
lines.zh: 征集：一个大饼干盒

lines.en: Who won the prize for the biggest biscuit?
lines.zh: 谁赢得了最大饼干的奖品？

lines.en: No one can avoid being influenced by advertisements.
lines.zh: 没人能避免受到广告的影响。

lines.en: Much as we may pride ourselves on our good taste,
lines.zh: 尽管我们可能为自己的好品味而自豪，

lines.en: we are no longer free to choose the things we want,
lines.zh: 但我们不再能自由选择我们想要的东西，

lines.en: for advertising exerts a subtle influence on us.
lines.zh: 因为广告对我们施加着微妙的影响。

lines.en: In their efforts to persuade us to buy this or that product,
lines.zh: 为了说服我们购买这种或那种产品，

lines.en: advertisers have made a close study of human nature and have classified all our little weaknesses.
lines.zh: 广告商们已经深入研究了人性，并对我们所有的小缺点进行了分类。

lines.en: Advertisers discovered years ago that all of us love to get something for nothing.
lines.zh: 广告商多年前就发现，我们所有人都喜欢不劳而获。

lines.en: An advertisement which begins with the magic word FREE can rarely go wrong.
lines.zh: 以“免费”这个神奇词语开头的广告很少会出错。

lines.en: These days, advertisers not only offer free samples,
lines.zh: 如今，广告商不仅提供免费样品，

lines.en: but free cars, free houses, and free trips round the world as well.
lines.zh: 还提供免费汽车、免费房屋，以及免费环球旅行。

lines.en: They devise hundreds of competitions which will enable us to win huge sums of money.
lines.zh: 他们设计了数百种竞赛，使我们能够赢得巨额奖金。

lines.en: Radio and television have made it possible for advertisers to capture the attention of millions of people in this way.
lines.zh: 无线电和电视使广告商能够通过这种方式吸引数百万人的注意力。

lines.en: During a radio programme, a company of biscuit manufacturers once asked listeners to bake biscuits and send them to their factory.
lines.zh: 在一个广播节目中，一家饼干制造商曾要求听众烘烤饼干并寄到他们的工厂。

lines.en: They offered to pay $10 a pound for the biggest biscuit baked by a listener.
lines.zh: 他们提出为听众烘烤的最大饼干支付每磅10美元。

lines.en: The response to this competition was tremendous.
lines.zh: 这项竞赛的反响非常热烈。

lines.en: Before long, biscuits of all shapes and sizes began arriving at the factory.
lines.zh: 不久，各种形状和大小的饼干开始运抵工厂。

lines.en: One lady brought biscuit on a wheelbarrow. It weighed nearly 500 pounds.
lines.zh: 一位女士用独轮手推车运来一块饼干。它重近500磅。

lines.en: A little later, a man came along with a biscuit which occupied the whole boot of his car.
lines.zh: 稍后，一位男士带来一块饼干，它占满了他的汽车后备箱。

lines.en: All the biscuits that were sent were carefully weighed.
lines.zh: 所有送来的饼干都被仔细称重。

lines.en: The largest was 713 pounds. It seemed certain that this would win the prize.
lines.zh: 最大的一块重713磅。这似乎肯定会赢得奖品。

lines.en: But just before the competition closed,
lines.zh: 但就在竞赛结束前，

lines.en: a lorry arrived at the factory with a truly colossal biscuit which weighed 2, 400 pounds.
lines.zh: 一辆卡车运载着一块重达2400磅的巨型饼干抵达工厂。

lines.en: It had been baked by a college student who had used over 1, 000 pounds of flour, 800 pounds of sugar,
lines.zh: 它是由一名大学生烘烤的，他使用了超过1000磅面粉、800磅糖、

lines.en: 200 pounds of fat, and 400 pounds of various other ingredients.
lines.zh: 200磅脂肪和400磅其他各种配料。

lines.en: It was so heavy that a crane had to be used to remove it from the lorry.
lines.zh: 它太重了，不得不动用起重机将其从卡车上卸下。

lines.en: The manufacturers had to pay more money than they had anticipated, for they bought the biscuit from the student for $24, 000.
lines.zh: 制造商不得不支付超出他们预期的金额，因为他们以24000美元从这名学生手中买下了这块饼干。
